name: google-ads-api-quickstart
description: | Guides developers through Google Ads API quickstart: credential setup, choosing from 6 client libraries/REST, configuring environments, and running a "retrieve campaigns" script. Troubleshoots common setup errors: USER_PERMISSION_DENIED, login_customer_id issues, and CLOUD_PROJECT_NOT_APPROVED_FOR_PRODUCTION (a Google Cloud project with Test access calling a production account).
author: google
